_doc: What the File tab collects. Patches unlock ("lock" is the neutral line shown before; "t" only once earned) by a rule the phone checks: day N reached, votes cast, rescues answered, gifts sent, cliffhangers seen, drops opened, artifacts found, story % discovered, watch streak. Artifacts come from rare drops and rare job results. Crew file entries unlock per crewmate as your astronaut gets to know them. STUBS: the content pass replaces these.

patches.t: Seven days out. Earth is a bright blue star now, with the Moon a fainter one beside it.
Twenty-one days down, twenty-one to go.
Flight day 42. The whole voyage is in the log.
A crewmate needed help and your ship pitched in.
patches.lock: Help a crewmate who needs it

patches.t: Something from your locker, sent across to another ship.
Read to the end of a long night, and came back in the morning.
Half of this voyage's story discovered.

artifacts.t: Your astronaut's training-class patch, frayed at one corner from years on a flight jacket.
All seven ships on the pad the night before launch, lit from below.
A wind-up stopwatch from the launch control room. Still keeps time.
A micrometeoroid, smaller than a grain of rice. Labelled and dated.
Packed for luck, lost in a tool pouch, and found again.

file._doc: Three entries per crewmate. met: they appear in your log. shared: your astronaut and they share a log line. traded: a gift or ask between you. {T} = crewmate, {S} = their ship, {lean} = their strongest character word.
file.shared: Has worked a shift alongside your astronaut. Reads as {lean}.
traded: Keeps a paper notebook of every alarm ever silenced.
Packed one real mug. Drinks from a pouch anyway.
Labels every cable, including the labelled ones.
Has a favourite wrench and won't say which.
Can name every star the tracker uses.
Saves the dessert pouches for Sundays.
Hums during checklists. Always the same tune.
